name: vintage
label: Vintage
css: .style-vintage { background-color: var(--slide-surface, #C0C0C0); background-image: url('data:image/svg+xml,<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="100" height="100"><filter id="noise"><feTurbulence type="fractalNoise" baseFrequency="0.9" numOctaves="4" seed="2"/></filter><rect width="100" height="100" fill="%23C0C0C0" filter="url(%23noise)" opacity="0.03"/></svg>'); position: relative; width: 1080px; height: 1080px; padding: 32px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; font-family: 'Silkscreen', monospace; color: var(--slide-text, #000000); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.8), inset 0 -2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.1), 3px 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.2); border: 2px solid var(--slide-text, #000000); } .style-vintage::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.1) 0%, rgba(0,0,0,0.05) 100%); pointer-events: none; border-radius: 0; } .style-vintage .hook { font-size: 80px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -2px; color: var(--slide-text, #000000); text-shadow: 2px 2px 0 var(--slide-primary, #008080); margin: 0; padding: 0; position: relative; z-index: 1; word-break: break-word; } .style-vintage .text { font-size: 50px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; color: var(--slide-text, #000000); margin: 0; padding: 0; position: relative; z-index: 1; word-break: break-word; } .style-vintage .step { position: absolute; top: 32px; right: 32px; font-size: 160px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--slide-text, #000000); opacity: 0.08; line-height: 1; z-index: 0; } .style-vintage .brand { position: absolute; bottom: 32px; left: 32px; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 400; color: var(--slide-text, #000000); letter-spacing: 0.5px; z-index: 1; } .slide-code.style-vintage { background-color: #1a1a1a; background-image: url('data:image/svg+xml,<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="100" height="100"><filter id="noise-dark"><feTurbulence type="fractalNoise" baseFrequency="0.9" numOctaves="4" seed="2"/></filter><rect width="100" height="100" fill="%231a1a1a" filter="url(%23noise-dark)" opacity="0.08"/></svg>'); color: #00FF00; border-color: #333333; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(0,255,0,0.1), inset 0 -2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.5), 3px 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.6); } .slide-code.style-vintage .hook { color: #00FF00; text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(0,255,0,0.5), 2px 2px 0 rgba(0,255,0,0.3); } .slide-code.style-vintage .text { color: #00FF00; } .slide-code.style-vintage .brand { color: #00FF00; } .slide-code.style-vintage .step { color: #00FF00; opacity: 0.12; } .slide-insight.style-vintage { background-color: #2d1b3d; background-image: url('data:image/svg+xml,<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="100" height="100"><filter id="noise-insight"><feTurbulence type="fractalNoise" baseFrequency="0.9" numOctaves="4" seed="3"/></filter><rect width="100" height="100" fill="%232d1b3d" filter="url(%23noise-insight)" opacity="0.1"/></svg>'); color: #E8D5F2; border-color: #664477; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(232,213,242,0.15), inset 0 -2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.4), 3px 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); } .slide-insight.style-vintage .hook { color: #E8D5F2; text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(232,213,242,0.4), 2px 2px 0 var(--slide-primary, #008080); } .slide-insight.style-vintage .text { color: #E8D5F2; } .slide-insight.style-vintage .insight-text { font-size: 24px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.6; color: #E8D5F2; background-color: rgba(0,0,0,0.3); padding: 16px 20px; border-left: 4px solid var(--slide-primary, #008080); margin: 16px 0; } .slide-insight.style-vintage .brand { color: #E8D5F2; } .slide-insight.style-vintage .step { color: #E8D5F2; opacity: 0.15; }
